title: Simulation 3D Camera Get
text: Camera image, 1 output, {Mounting location} sets Sensor mounting location; {Sensor identifier} sets the number to identify unique sensor, {Parent name} sets the name of parent, {Specify offset} sets the offset from mounting location, {Relative translation [X, Y, Z]} sets the translation offset from mounting location, {Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw]} sets the rotational offset from mounting location, {Sample time}, {Horizontal resolution} sets the pixels uint32, {Vertical resolution} sets the pixels uint32 and {Horizontal field of view} sets the field of view single. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: 3D output camera image m -by- n -by-3 array of RGB triplet values

params.name: Sensor identifier
params.values: Number to identify unique sensor 0 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Parent name
params.values: Name of parent Scene Origin (default) | character vector

params.name: Mounting location
params.values: Sensor mounting location Origin (default) | Front bumper | Rear bumper | Right mirror | Left mirror | Rearview mirror | Hood center | Roof center

params.name: Specify offset
params.values: Specify offset from mounting location off (default) | on

params.name: Relative translation [X, Y, Z]
params.values: Translation offset from mounting location [0,0,0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw]
params.values: Rotational offset from mounting location [0,0,0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector
